name: Nishant Kumar
headline:
Every frame.
A reason to stay.
intro: I turn raw footage into stories people feel. Video editing, motion graphics, and scroll-stopping content for creators and brands.

projects.title: Beyond the ordinary
projects.summary: Atmosphere, deliberate pacing, and a color palette that sets the mood before the story begins.
projects.brief: Create an atmospheric opening that makes the viewer pause and lean into the story.
projects.approach: A slow push-in, restrained typography, and a warm–cool color contrast create depth without overwhelming the frame.
projects.deliverables: Cinematic opening · Color direction · Title treatment

projects.title: Motion Graphic Reels
projects.summary: Big ideas in motion. A punchy type sequence built around rhythm, contrast, and clean transitions.
projects.brief: Build a short, memorable visual identity for a creator or campaign launch.
projects.approach: Oversized type, animated graphic shapes, and tightly timed changes keep each beat focused on one idea.
projects.deliverables: Animated title · Graphic transitions · Campaign opener

projects.title: GTA 5 FUNNY EDITING
projects.summary: An electric visual direction for gaming highlights, channel intros, and high-energy creator edits.
projects.brief: Develop a distinct gaming opener with enough energy to introduce a highlight reel.
projects.approach: A neon visual system, a short countdown, and precise graphic movement build anticipation before the first moment.
projects.deliverables: Gaming opener · Highlight direction · Channel graphics

projects.title: Reels Editing Tutorial Clean & Minimal Style
projects.summary: Clean. Minimal. Powerful. This reels editing tutorial breaks down a full edit style built for short form content that actually holds attention. A real look at reels editing tips used to create a scroll-stopping reels editing video from start to finish.
projects.brief: Introduce a short-form editing style with a clear opening hook and mobile-first composition.
projects.approach: One message per beat, high-contrast captions, and generous safe areas keep the story readable on a phone.
projects.deliverables: Vertical short · Animated captions · Hook variation

projects.title: UGC VIDEO
projects.summary: UGC Video Wake Up With Bouncy, "Glass Skin"! ✨ LANEIGE Peony Sleeping Mask
projects.brief: Set a visual mood for an artist intro or event teaser.
projects.approach: Layered rings of light and a slow-moving title turn a simple composition into a hypnotic opening.
projects.deliverables: Artist intro · Event teaser direction · Motion loop

projects.title: A story worth telling
projects.summary: Clear structure, expressive titles, and visual breathing room that make a story easy to follow.
projects.brief: Create an opening title direction for a narrative YouTube video.
projects.approach: A simple chapter structure and editorial typography introduce the subject without adding visual clutter.
projects.deliverables: Story opener · Chapter graphics · YouTube edit direction
